new_results.statement: For Z2=e2(M^T M)>0 and natural e2 row marginals alpha_i<=q/2 with 1<=q<r<2, int |phi_R|^r <= [2 pi r/(r-q)] [B_beta prod H_q(alpha_i)]^(1/2) Z2^(-1/4), hence p_R lies in L^{r/(r-1)} with the explicit norm in the report.

If an original-coordinate nonzero pivot a is completed exactly and its Schur residual has such an e2 block, then ||p_Q||_inf <= K(q,r)|a|^(-1/2)Z2^(-1/8), K(q,r)=4 sqrt(e)q^(-1/4)(2-r)^((r-3)/2)r^((1-r)/2)(r-q)^(-1/2). Essential boundedness only; continuity not proved.
For natural e2 marginal alpha_i, (1-alpha_i)Z2=e2(M[-i,:]^T M[-i,:]); alpha_i=1 forces the other rows to have rank at most one, i.e. exact hub plus rank-one bank.
